input.sql: select distinct head, ledger from balances where head like '%INV%' or head like '%STOCK%' or lower(ledger) like '%stock%' or lower(ledger) like '%inventor%' limit 50

paragraphs.text: The loaded data cannot say how many units of your best-selling item are in stock. It holds only ledger balances in money and pending bills. It has no item-level sales, no item names and no quantities. Stock appears only as a single value in the Closing Stock ledger, so neither the best-selling item nor its unit count can be identified.
